title: serapias lingua var. parviflora
intro: Serapias lingua var. parviflora, commonly known as the small-flowered tongue orchid, is a type of orchid plant belonging to the family Orchidaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Serapias lingua var. parviflora include acting as an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and bronchodilator, which can help alleviate symptoms of coughs, colds, and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
